Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature or spirit you could attempt a Passing on

You read the ledger before you sign it. You learn exactly what that Passing would cost you in thresholds, and whether paying it would move you into a higher band of Passage — including whether it would reach the Cap. The answer accounts for anything currently modifying the cost, such as a deferred cost you are carrying or a Path feature that steepens it.
